about.title: What knowly is
about.intro: knowly is your company's internal knowledge base with an AI layer on top — instead of digging through folders or asking a coworker who might be on vacation, your team asks questions in plain language and gets an answer grounded in the articles you've already written.

articles.title: Your article library
articles.description: Text, images, and PDFs your team uploads become articles that are searchable by meaning, not just keyword.

citedAnswers.title: Cited answers
citedAnswers.description: The assistant answers natural-language questions while always pointing back to the article it got the information from — never a generic answer with no source.

permissions.title: Access under control
permissions.description: Who can view, upload, edit, or delete articles — and who can see each conversation — is governed by real permissions, not trust.

isolation.title: Your data, isolated
isolation.description: Every company is a tenant with fully isolated data — one team's knowledge never leaks into another's answers.
